desc: A short formal letter dated 3 October 2017 in which Luis Elizondo writes: 'Effective 4 October 2017, I humbly submit my resignation as Director, National Programs Special Management Staff... I respectfully request I receive a deferred retirement.' It was hand-delivered rather than routed through standard channels, per Elizondo's attorney Todd McMurtry, and reporting identifies the recipient as his supervisor John Garrity. Released in OSD/JS FOIA case 18-F-0324. This letter is the load-bearing document of the whole domain: it establishes, in Elizondo's own hand and on the Department's own paper, the exact title he held and the exact date he left — the two facts the Department has never contested even while contesting his program role.
label: Elizondo Resignation Letter #1, 3 October 2017
